linux.liveAcceptance: Inherited unchanged network architecture from accepted 1.1.0

architecture.windows: Native WPF + fixed-command Windows service + bundled PowerShell 7.6.6 + owned demand-start ctrld + Loopback ULA/NRPT + zapret/WinDivert + service-mediated verified direct updater
architecture.linux: GTK/Adwaita + protected backend + ctrld/systemd-resolved + nftables/NFQUEUE + nfqws

directUpdate.windows: SCM control 131 -> LocalSystem service -> GitHub latest -> GitHub digest == SHA256SUMS == file SHA256 -> silent Inno Setup /DIR registered install path -> installer completion marker
directUpdate.initialTransitionFrom110: One privileged 1.2.0 install is required because v1.1.0 predates the service-mediated updater.
directUpdate.linux: Existing verified GitHub latest + SHA256SUMS flow

limitations: The one-time transition from Windows v1.1.0 to v1.2.0 may require UAC; later in-app updates are designed to require no UAC.
Effectiveness may vary if network filtering behavior changes.
